value.script:
<arc:info title="Account Code Conditional" desc="Maps N104 value to the appropriate account code.">
  <input name="FilePath"        desc="The sending file path." />
  <input name="XPath"           desc="The current xpath in the loop." />
  <input name="*"               desc="The information of the current loop." />
</arc:info>

<arc:set attr="n104" value="[xpath('/Interchange/FunctionalGroup/TransactionSet/TX-00401-810/N1Loop1/N1/N104')]" />

<arc:if exp='"[n104]" == "CL899" || "[n104]" == "CL900" || "[n104]" == "CR565"'>
  <arc:set attr="result.text" value="01MSK-97020-00000-00206" />
  <arc:else>
    <arc:if exp='"[n104]" == "CM255"'>
      <arc:set attr="result.text" value="01MEM-19752-00000-00244" />
      <arc:else>
        <arc:set attr="result.text" value="null" />
      </arc:else>
    </arc:if>
  </arc:else>
</arc:if>
